title: Add Fork & Soak endpoint and Timeline UI action to simulate directly into an isolated branch

sections.what: Allow running headless multi-day world soaks directly onto a forked Timeline branch with periodic checkpoints and branch-scoped StreamStore milestones.
sections.why: Soak Lab currently runs in a throwaway memory copy, so users cannot fork a branch, soak 7-30 days, and browse the resulting checkpoints and events on the Timeline.
sections.how: Add POST /api/timeline/fork-soak in routes/timeline_ops.py accepting {minutes|days|hours, checkpoint_every_minutes, label, fork_tick}: forks a branch via TimelineManager, runs timeskip.advance_world in chunks recording periodic checkpoints + StreamStore milestone events under the new branch_id, and returns branch summary + soak stats. Wire a Fork & Soak button into renderSlotDrawer in static/js/stream/timeline-view.ts.

acceptance.text: POST /api/timeline/fork-soak forks a new branch at fork_tick, advances the world in configurable chunks with periodic checkpoints, logs soak milestones into StreamStore under the new branch_id, and leaves the parent branch untouched
TimelineView slot drawer exposes a Fork & Soak action to simulate days/weeks on an isolated fork and inspect the resulting branch on the Timeline

custom.browser_ui: Clicking Fork & Soak in the TimelineView slot drawer creates a new branch, runs headless multi-day simulation with checkpoints, and immediately displays the soaked branch on the Timeline.
